note: 052_mi_kind_deferred.sql (HELD) -- composite (kind_set_by, tenant_id) -> users(id, tenant_id), ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT; nullable (set only when a PM classifies). Same reasoning as capture_documents.sent_by: capture tests use only users of their own capture-fixture tenants (Option Y); service_role has no DELETE on this table, so a generic sweep delete would error, not no-op.
